predict.question: B prepares six, approves eight and acts on six decisions/hour. What is B’s toy result?

exploreHint: Run both cases; compare the changed input.
bookIdea: Turn the Ship Around! describes moving authority toward people able to act on local knowledge.
modelBoundary: A completes {A} decisions/hour; B completes {B}. Approval stops limiting flow after redistribution, but preparation and action now jointly cap it at six. Only serial capacity is modeled; knowledge quality, military operations and leadership outcomes are outside it.
doesItHoldUp: Does it hold up? The arithmetic follows our assumptions; real-world applicability and book attribution remain unverified.
